entries.title: Main Page
entries.summary: The Secretary Name National Archives documents SimDemocracy, an online democratic community founded in 2019. The collection emphasizes laws and links to legislation, executive orders, case law, historical material and newcomer guidance. This is an original orientation summary, not a reproduction of the archive page.
